walkthroughs.body_html:
(Alice, knows, Bob) expresses Alice knows Bob.

Subjects, predicates and objects are URIs in formal RDF.

FOAF (Friend of a Friend) provides knows, name etc.

Adopting a common ontology aids data integration.

SELECT?friend WHERE {:Alice:knows?friend }

Pattern matches the triple store and returns matches.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between an IP address and a MAC address?
options: IP is for input, MAC is for output.
MAC is a hardware identifier (fixed); IP is a logical network address (assignable).
They are the same thing with different names.

mcqs.q: Why are passwords stored as hashes rather than plaintext?
options: Hashes are one-way - even an attacker who steals them cannot easily recover passwords.
Hashes are encryption that can be decrypted with the right key.
Hashes compress the data to save space.
